== Description ==

[[Scott Lingrell]] (left, navy Philadelphia Union jersey, white hair, name tag, holding a drink), [[Kyle Krueger]] (back center, maroon T-shirt), and [[Justin Miyashiro]] (right, glasses, goatee, black “OMG it’s R2D2” tee, looking at cards) at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 4 October 2025.
